sixNativeCaseBodies.catalog: Four fixed check calls plus the unchanged cancel/timeout loop.

checks: probeAlive retains the original falsey-PID early return, exactly one signal-zero probe for a supplied PID, false only for ESRCH, true for presence, and rethrows the original permission/error object. Proc observations do not determine this result.

Registered roles are limited to wrapper/native PIDs from the injected test worker. An unknown or ambiguous PID cannot initiate a probe observation. Each role has one initial proc read and at most one current probe observation.

Each proc read uses only /proc/<validated positive signed-32-bit PID>/stat, one readonly no-follow/nonblocking open, a buffer of8193 bytes, at most4 reads, before/after held identity checks on a successful bounded read, and one close attempt.
A zero advertised proc size does not bypass or replace the observed byte bound. Invalid types, changed identity, malformed UTF-8, missing/inaccessible files and close errors remain UNAVAILABLE.
The parser retains only PID, process state, parent/group/session IDs and bounded decimal start ticks. It drops comm, raw fields, arguments and environment. Diagnostic errors use fixed codes.

Identity comparison requires both initial/current observations and compares start ticks plus proc device/inode. It reports observed fields, not an atomic PID identity guarantee. Zombie state and changed identity do not convert PRESENT into ABSENT.
Lifecycle fields are limited to spawn, exit and close, one each, with bounded exit/signal metadata and relative timing. No extra wait, retry or terminating signal was added.

The native check task bodies and liveness assertions remain byte-preserved. The reporter adds diagnostic snapshots around their original success/failure result. CLI execution remains behind require.main, so the new harness can import the reporter without starting native checks.
The documentation retains run93 network-case failure, keeps all native cases outside release credit, and states that extra proc reads can affect scheduling without proving a process cleanup fix.
limits: Source-only independent review. Parent owns reproduction of the reported53 synthetic harness passes.
No current native liveness observation was collected. Native cleanup behavior and the run93 failure cause remain pending CI.
